blocks.text: FRANKFURT, Germany — Two Filipinos were killed on Sunday when a tourist bus carrying them to the Oktoberfest beer festival in southern Germany overturned on a motorway, police said. The accident, which occurred around 0400 GMT, left eight others seriously injured. The tourist bus or coach, chartered by a travel company, was carrying a group of 33 Filipino tourists and two Italian drivers to the Oktoberfest in Munich, a spokeswoman for the Upper Bavaria police prefecture told AFP.
